correctness.rationale: The original package contains a false exact bulk identity: it subtracts (-1)^k q_n^(n+1) instead of (-1)^k q_n^n from Jiang’s eigenvalue. Algebra leaves a nonzero term of size O(n^-1) in the old identity. The complete replacement RESULT.md now sets b_n=q_n^n and proves exactly lambda_{n,k}-(-1)^k b_n = p_n^2(1-(-1)^k b_n)/(p_n^2+q_n ell_{n,k}). This repairs the uniform bulk estimate, retaining the correct n exp(-2ct)+o(1) theorem. Independently checked the exact kernel, symmetry, Doeblin minorization and cosine eigenvalues for n=4,7,16,31 and three cut intensities; this confirms finite identities, not the infinite limit. The corrected low/bulk proof bounds low modes by n^alpha r^{2t}=o(1) and the bulk by O(k^-2), uniformly in starts and integer times.
residual_risks: The conclusion concerns one tagged-card marginal, not mixing of the full permutation deck.
All n-limit claims rely on analytic bounds, not the finite checks.

originality.rationale: Jiang supplies the complete exact one-card spectrum, an indispensable acknowledged input, but its stated full-deck cutoff is in the fixed-p regime. The corrected finding establishes a separate, uniform p_n=c/n singular chi-square window and a Doeblin-vs-chi-square mixing separation. Jonasson proves fixed-parameter whole-deck bounds, not this two-metric one-card limit. The finite spectrum makes the limit derivable but does not itself state or automatically justify the uniform low/bulk asymptotic. Best-of-knowledge originality is conditional on unaccessed primary sections.
